content: Terminal product baseline from current emulators: tabs and split panes with draggable dividers; scrollback with regex/case/whole-word search; copy/paste and configurable scrollback; session restore of windows/tabs/splits/terminal text (best examples keep last 5 sessions); reconnect and keep-alive; saved connection profiles distinct from live-session persistence; link detection; search highlighting; configurable fonts/keybindings; notifications; mouse reporting and selection bypass. For a client/server multiplexer (tmux/zellij/Herdr), persistence is achieved by reattaching to a live server; restart restore reconstructs layout but kills processes, and screen replay is opt-in because output may contain secrets.
